observations: Photo 0 shows the retail box for an Evergood UPS.
The box indicates a capacity of 1500VA.
The box features the brand name 'EVERGOOD' and the text 'BESTEFFECT'.
The actual UPS device is not visible in the photo.
There is a watermark 'SETRACK DIGITAL SOLUTION' across the center of the image.

claims.evidence: The brand name is visible on the box in photo 0.
The box in photo 0 specifies 1500VA, which is equivalent to 1.5 KVA.

risks.risk: The box may be empty or contain a different item.
risks.proof: A photo of the actual UPS unit outside of its packaging.

risks.risk: The internal lead-acid batteries may be dead or exhausted.
risks.proof: A video showing the UPS powering a significant load (e.g., a desktop PC) while unplugged from the wall.
risks.if_unproven: priced as requiring immediate battery replacement

risks.risk: The unit may have internal electronic faults or damaged outlets.
risks.proof: Photos of the rear panel and a video of the unit successfully completing a self-test.

proof_requests: Photo of the actual UPS unit out of the box.
Photo of the specification sticker on the back or bottom of the unit.
Video of the unit turned on and supporting a load without being plugged into mains power.
response.reason: Only the retail packaging is shown. Without photos of the actual device, its existence, physical condition, and functional state cannot be verified.
